content_metadata.description: Noble Ackerson delivers a thought-provoking presentation on the reliability issues of large language models (LLMs) and explores potential solutions through humor and real-world examples.

qAndA.question: What is the name of the awards that Noble created for failures in large language models?

qAndA.answer: They should be transparent about the limitations of the tools.
qAndA.question: According to Noble, what is one way that companies can improve the user experience with large language models?
What specific technique does Noble demonstrate as a way to create more reliable AI chatbots?

qAndA.answer: It is crucial for DevOps professionals to be involved in managing the complexity of these tools and ensuring that they are used responsibly.

youtube_description: Synopsis: Embark on an enlightening journey with Noble as he tackles the challenges of integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) into enterprise environments. Understand the inherent unreliability of these models and explore innovative solutions, ranging from vector databases to prompt chaining, that aim to enhance the trustworthiness of LLMs in crucial applications. About Noble Ackerson: An authority on data ethics and emergent technology, Noble is at the forefront of applied AI integration at Ventera Corporation, Virginia. His illustrious career boasts accolades as an AI Product Manager, Google Design Sprint Master, and former Google Developers Expert. With a legacy of crafting award-winning mobile and advanced analytics solutions, Noble's passion extends to mentoring underrepresented communities. [Read more](https://medium.com/@nobleackerson)
